tests.name: build-info answers JSON (the runner confirms the verified commit from it)

tests.reason: Defect 2: find_perfect_match can post the member's ask to user_intents without a confirm step (a write to the shared production database), so it cannot be probed read-only on staging. These suites pin that the tool reads only life_compass (never vitana_index_scores), asks the member when no ask is given, and that discovery-tools(-repository).ts name no health table.

Defect 3: find_perfect_product / find_perfect_practitioner run only inside an authenticated ORB voice session, which a read-only staging suite cannot open. The suites pin the corrected life_compass query (primary_goal, is_active, newest first, limit 1, never current_goal), the goal in the rationale, the logged warning on a read error, and the VTID-05025 commerce/health boundary.

Defect 5: POST /api/v1/health/wearables/ingest answering 410 ENDPOINT_RETIRED is a POST, and staging suites send only GETs (a non-GET is allowed only as a 401/403 auth-rejected probe, and this route now answers 410 before auth). The suite proves the 410 with and without a token and that no Supabase client, RPC or OASIS event is touched. The revoke migration itself is proven by SQL-WEARABLE-SAMPLES-RPC-REVOKE.yml on a throwaway Postgres and is applied to the live database only via RUN-MIGRATION.yml after Gate 2.

The find_perfect_match tool description changed (no weakest-pillar personalisation). The voice-payload and characterization snapshots were regenerated for that description only, and the VTID-04560 role suite pins the ORB profile's tool catalog; none of this is observable on staging without an authenticated voice session.
